limits: the sizes are the exact formula Σ c_i·log2 p_i (W-3)
name: W1_code_growth

provenance.source: Gödel 1931, section 2, in Martin Hirzel's translation; The Gödel Method handover, W-1

statement: Gödel's codes explode exactly where Ph-2 and Ph-3 say: the set axiom has 141771 bits; lifted one type it has 2349852 and two types 40175911 (a type-5 variable's sign code is 17^5 = 1,419,857, in an exponent); a proof's own number, 2^Φ(f1)·3^Φ(f2)···, would have about Φ(f1) bits, astronomically many, so it is never built. Definition 41 is decided from the size formula with one comparison, never by factoring.
